title: Powering a Backyard Shed: trenching, conduit, and panel installation (Ask This Old House)
summary: In this This Old House episode, Heath and Jeff plan, trench, and wire a new electrical feed from the house to a newly built shed. The team assesses the site, routes a trench between the shed and the house, installs outdoor conduit with LB and expansion fittings, and places a ground system. They set up a panel, pull feeders, and wire the shed to meet minimum code requirements (at least one receptacle and one light), then perform a power-on test to verify the install. The process emphasizes safe coordination (Dig Safe), trench backfill with a sand bed, protection of the conduit, proper conduit orientation to reduce water intrusion, and a reminder that live work should be performed by a licensed electrician when disconnecting service.
